name: a param-bearing where clause separates from the column, and the sort follows the column
description: get_table_name passes params into table_alias for where clauses as well as for columns, so a where clause carrying a different as_of_month_day than the column separates aliases identically -- two joins, two anchors (03-01 for the column, 09-01 for the filter). The second half is what a grep cannot check: the sort must resolve to the COLUMN's select alias and not the where clause's, so the ordinal in the ORDER BY has to point at the 03-01 join. A build that shared one alias across the two would sort on the filter's boundary while displaying the column's.
